newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as food,cement shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as food,cement shares rise.

text.p: Dhaka stocks, backed by the gains of cement and food shares, closed sharply higher ahead of Friday's Moslem weekend, brokers said.
Brokers said the majority of shares rose amid buying pressure as the market continued its rally for a second day after a brief correction earlier this week.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all share price index rose 15.91 points or 1.02 percent at 1,562.66 on a turnover of 151.9 million taka. Of the 99 issues traded, 66 closed up, 32 ended down and one remained unchanged.

Food share AMCL Pran rose 68.47 taka to 1,493.41, Confidence Cement gained 70.16 to 1,554.04, Beximco Textile rose 6.54 to 139.14, Bata Shoe gained 1.23 to 194.08 and Eastern Cables lost 32.73 to 701.07.
